name: CORD v2: Consolidated Receipt Dataset
description: Phone photos of Indonesian shop and restaurant receipts with word boxes, text and semantic fields (menu items, prices, totals). Text is mixed Indonesian/English.
redistribution: yes, with attribution (CC BY 4.0); not redistributed here
size: 1,000 receipts (800 train / 100 validation / 100 test); the pack uses test + validation (200), shards 234 MB + 242 MB
download_status_here: not downloaded here: host not reachable from the sandbox (huggingface.co)
notes: Not English-only (O1 is English first): useful for numbers and layout, report separately from English receipts.
Phone photos, some skewed or crumpled, but conditions are not labelled; count only pages the owner tags as hard.
Pinned to commit 7f0115a4b758a71d6473b8d085751692da2fef98; sha256 from the Hugging Face LFS pointers (read 23 Nov 2026). Sizes are recorded in the lock on first download.
The converter needs pyarrow (Apache-2.0) to read parquet.

pack.page_addressing: page ID = <shard>/<row index, 3 digits>; columns image (struct with bytes) and ground_truth (JSON string)

estimate.how: two parquet shards whole (234 MB + 242 MB as listed on Hugging Face); parquet rows cannot be read with the standard library, so no range reads
